characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Pokémon anime
characters.summary: Flareon is a fire-type evolution of Eevee that generates intense heat inside its fluffy fur coat. It relies on physical strikes and fiery breath or projectile attacks to overwhelm opponents.

mechanisms: Thick fur coat that radiates heat to deter physical approaches

weaknesses: Vulnerable to water, ground, and rock-type attacks
limitations: Internal body temperature can rise dangerously high if it moves around too much during battle.

sources.supports: Basic stats, fire typing, and standard movepool including Flamethrower and Fire Blast.

feats.claim: Heats up its body temperature to up to 1,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entries

campaignTags.claim: Flareon is a Fire-type Pokémon capable of generating and breathing intense fire.

unknowns: Exact physical output limits outside of stated Pokédex temperature thresholds.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Pokémon anime
characters.summary: Gastly is a Ghost/Poison-type Pokémon composed mostly of gaseous matter, allowing it to bypass physical barriers and suffocate opponents with toxic gas.

mechanisms: Gaseous body that passes harmlessly through physical attacks

weaknesses: Vulnerable to ghost and psychic-type attacks
limitations: Body can be blown away by strong winds due to its gaseous composition.

sources.supports: Ghost/Poison typing, gaseous physiology, and levitation.

feats.claim: Wraps opponents in its gaseous body to weaken and eventually knock them out.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entries

campaignTags.claim: Gastly naturally floats and moves through the air without wings.

unknowns: True physical mass distribution across different environmental conditions.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Pokémon anime
characters.summary: Gengar is a shadowy Ghost/Poison-type that hides in the shadows of its targets to drain their body heat and curse them. It uses a mix of stealth, status-inflicting moves, and direct shadow-based energy attacks.

mechanisms: Ability to hide completely within shadows

weaknesses: Vulnerable to ghost, psychic, dark, and ground-type attacks
limitations: Cannot hide in areas completely devoid of light or shadow casting.

sources.supports: Ghost/Poison typing, shadow manipulation, and standard movepool.

feats.claim: Steals the warmth of surrounding areas, dropping temperatures drastically.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entries

campaignTags.claim: Gengar hovers and flies naturally in the air.
Gengar can hide completely inside the shadow of any target.

unknowns: Exact limits of its shadow concealment in dimensions outside normal space.

characters.summary: Gigantamax Gengar takes on a massive, cavernous form with a wide-open mouth that serves as a portal to the afterlife. It traps opponents inside its body to subject them to curses and thermal drains.

mechanisms: Immunity to normal-type and fighting-type moves due to ghost typing

weaknesses: Vulnerable to ghost, dark, psychic, and ground-type attacks
Reverts to normal size after the Gigantamax duration expires
characters.formDifferences: Expands Gengar to a massive size with a portal-like mouth and grants access to G-Max Terror.

sources.supports: Gigantamax Gengar form details, gigantic proportions, and G-Max Terror move.

unknowns: Exact structural mechanics of the interior portal dimension.

characters.continuity: Pokémon X and Y / Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire
characters.summary: Mega Gengar unlocks a connection to another dimension through its partially sunken body. It gains enhanced special attack power and a trapping ability that prevents opponents from escaping.

mechanisms: Enhanced evasiveness and heightened special statistics

weaknesses: Vulnerable to ghost, dark, psychic, and ground-type attacks
Requires a Gengarite Mega Stone held during battle
limitations: Lasts only for the duration of a single battle.
characters.formDifferences: Gains the Shadow Tag ability, preventing opponent escape, and increases all offensive output.

sources.supports: Mega Gengar stats, Shadow Tag ability, and design features.

conditional.dependsOn: Holding the Gengarite item and resonance with a Trainer's Mega Bracelet

campaignTags.claim: Mega Gengar floats effortlessly in the air.

unknowns: The absolute depth of the dimensional void accessed via its body.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Pokémon anime
characters.summary: Geodude is a Rock/Ground-type Pokémon possessing a rugged, boulder-like body. It relies on its hard stone exterior to endure hits while delivering heavy physical tackles and punches.

mechanisms: Solid rock armor body capable of deflecting light impacts

weaknesses: Extremely vulnerable to water and grass-type attacks; also weak to ice, fighting, ground, and steel-type moves
mobility: Rolling across terrain, short walking strides
limitations: Limited mobility outside of rolling or short hops.

sources.supports: Rock/Ground typing, physical defense statistics, and movepool.

feats.claim: Crashes into opponents with a hard stone body, using mountainsides as camouflage.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entries

unknowns: Exact mineral composition variations across different geographical regions.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Pokémon anime
characters.summary: Gloom is a Grass/Poison-type Pokémon that secretes foul-smelling fluids from its pistil and drool from its mouth to incapacitate enemies with overwhelming stench.

mechanisms: Foul odor drives away attackers before physical contact occurs

weaknesses: Vulnerable to fire, flying, psychic, and ice-type attacks
limitations: Slow movement speed in standard terrain.

sources.supports: Grass/Poison typing, odor secretion mechanics, and abilities.

feats.claim: Releases a stench so foul that it can cause fainting from a distance of over a mile.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entries

unknowns: Exact chemical makeup of the honey-like nectar it produces.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Pokémon anime
characters.summary: Golbat is a Poison/Flying-type bat Pokémon equipped with sharp fangs designed to pierce thick hides and drain blood from its targets during aerial swoops.

mechanisms: Aerial agility and erratic flight patterns

weaknesses: Vulnerable to electric, ice, psychic, and rock-type attacks
limitations: Becomes sluggish and heavy if it drinks too much blood, hindering flight.

sources.supports: Poison/Flying typing, flight abilities, and blood-draining characteristics.

feats.claim: Drinks large quantities of blood from victims in a single feeding session before flying off.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entries

campaignTags.claim: Golbat possesses large wings enabling sustained natural flight.

unknowns: Maximum flight altitude and endurance limits.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Pokémon anime
characters.summary: Goldeen is a Water-type goldfish Pokémon that swims gracefully at high speeds and uses its sharp horn to ram opponents in aquatic environments.

mechanisms: Rapid swimming speed to evade capture

weaknesses: Vulnerable to electric and grass-type attacks
Helpless when removed from water for extended periods
mobility: Swimming, occasional short leaps out of water
limitations: Cannot survive indefinitely out of water.

sources.supports: Water typing, horn attributes, and swimming capabilities.

feats.claim: Swims at speeds up to five knots against strong river currents.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entries

campaignTags.claim: Goldeen lives entirely in aquatic environments and swims with high speed.
Goldeen extracts oxygen from water using gills.
Goldeen is a fast, agile swimmer.

unknowns: Exact force output of its horn strike when hitting non-aquatic armor.

characters.summary: Golduck is a Water-type duck Pokémon featuring streamlined webbed limbs and potent psychic capabilities, allowing it to move at supreme velocities through water and unleash mental attacks.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to electric and grass-type attacks
limitations: Psychic powers occasionally drain mental focus if overused.

sources.supports: Water typing, webbed limbs, speed stats, and psychic movepool.

feats.claim: Swims smoothly and effortlessly even in rough, stormy seas.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entries

campaignTags.claim: Golduck is an aquatic Pokémon built for river and ocean environments.
Golduck swims faster than any human swimmer using its webbed flippers.
Golduck can utilize psychic moves like Confusion and Psybeam.
